metadata.title: Your licence
metadata.description: Buy a licence, then find your key and the machines that use it here.

pending: Your key is being issued. Refresh in a moment.
revoked: This licence is no longer active. Write to us if that looks wrong.
usage: A purchase and a valid key are required to install and use the CLI. Run this command and provide your key when prompted. Keep the key private.
changeTier: To move to another tier, email <mail>{email}</mail>.

buy.title: Get your licence
buy.description: One payment, lifetime core updates and no per-user fees. Every tier includes the CLI and unlimited projects.
buy.agreement: By continuing to checkout, you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <licence>Commercial Licence</licence>. Read the <refunds>Refund Policy</refunds> before purchasing.

chosen.title: Continue with {tier}
chosen.description: You chose {tier}. Pay once on Polar and your licence key appears here a few seconds later.

unlocks.title: Courses included with {tiers}
unlocks.description: Your account cannot open {lessons, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} in {courses, plural, one {# course} other {# courses}} yet.
unlocks.lessons: {count, plural, one {# locked lesson} other {# locked lessons}}

activating.title: Payment received
activating.body: Your licence is being activated. This takes a few seconds, and the page updates by itself.

delayed.title: Activation is taking longer than usual
delayed.body: Polar has not confirmed your payment to us yet. That normally takes seconds, so check again in a minute. If your licence still has not arrived, email <mail>{email}</mail> with the checkout reference below and we will activate it by hand.

activations.title: Machines
activations.description: Each machine you scaffold on uses one slot. Free a slot when you stop using a machine.
activations.none: No machines have used this key yet.

agreement: The <licence>Commercial Licence</licence> covers the CLI and your rights to generated applications.
